2: "You’ve described Supergoop!’s partnership with Envive AI and its goal-oriented AI agent, which you've also cited in a published article about Supergoop!."

   Fix: Rewrite it to say only this fact, in your own words: "Solution Supergoop! partnered with Envive AI to implement a goal-oriented AI agent that personalized the shopper journey.", or write DELETE.

Return one line per sentence and nothing else, in this form:
